DORA.name: Digital Operational Resilience Act and its regulatory technical standards on the ICT risk management framework
DORA.note: Crosswalk by JSolve B.V., not published by the EU or Microsoft. A test maps to a DORA article (Art.) or an article of the regulatory technical standards (RTS Art.) through the MCSB v2 controls it implements, or directly for resilience checks outside MCSB. Only the articles with a technical Azure side are in scope; governance, incident classification and reporting, resilience testing (including TLPT), contracts, the register of information and exit plans cannot be assessed from configuration. A mapping means the configuration contributes to the article, not that the article is met.
